details:
I feel like the Live Now tab has changed recently, mostly for the better, so I'd like to explore it and how to continue making it better. 

My main premise with this is: When I think of the "Live Now" tab, I think of "Events that are live... now. Right now."

When I open the Live Now tab I am greeted with a lot of things!

Row 1: Discover:

If I wanted to Discover worlds, I would select Worlds > Popular. I want to see which EVENTS are live now, not what random worlds are Live Now. I kind of get the idea here, but I'm not sure I would use this option here.

Row 2: Friend Locations:

I could see this being useful for the wider public, yes. Not so much for me, but I recognize this is important, absolutely keep it.

Row 3: Group Activity: (For groups that I am in right now) 

Also useful for the wider public, yes!

----

Now I have a lot of things in the following rows that aren't quite... Live Now.

Row 4: New To VRChat? Find Welcoming Groups Here:

I get that this row, pretty much replaces Groups Fair. 2 Events are "Live" right now, and there's another one starting in 2 hours. I get that there's a "LIVE" red button at the top, but when looking at a glance, I don't care what time it initially went live, I care that it is live now. 

Instead of displaying ALL LIVE and FUTURE events in the LIVE NOW tab, that everything that really is LIVE NOW should be displayed, and then a "See future events" button to the right   (Where Weekly Hangout currently is) so that I could see stuff that isnt LIVE NOW, but LIVE LATER. :3 Having future events that are NOT live now in the "LIVE NOW" tab confuses my smol brain. 

ALTERNATIVELY, I think that EITHER the date/time should be removed and replaced with some sort of "LIVE NOW" button in that spot. Or at the very least, move the LIVE button to the left of it. I feel like I am constantly trying to figure out if the event is live or not before remembering that there even IS a LIVE button. (If, for example, right now there are no LIVE events to remember that button's existence even... exists)

Row 5, 6, 7: Music, Games, Avatars

Similar to the above, there are none that are LIVE NOW, but only LIVE LATER.

Row 8: Upcoming

Considering the above rows are littered with upcoming events already, this seems redundant.

Row 9: Browse Events

Browse? Browse how? How is this different from any of the above rows? Why are events that started (and ended) [and very much not live anymore] many hours ago still showing up here?

 

TLDR: Anyway, I love the changes so far, but let's keep it going! :3 I really wanna see events that are LIVE NOW being the focus here, vs "LIVE LATER" <3
title: Make LIVE NOW tab focus on events that are LIVE NOW instead of LIVE LATER
